Describe a restart by its timing and trigger

A television that repeatedly returns to the Toshiba logo is behaving differently from one that loses mains power. Note whether the standby indicator remains lit, whether sound cuts out and whether restarting happens immediately or after viewing for a while. Those observations guide checks of software, storage, connected equipment and power delivery; they do not identify a failed board on their own.

If it is safe to use the normal controls, note whether unplugging an external USB accessory changes the behaviour. Do not run repeated resets or force an update while the TV is unstable. A model-specific recovery procedure may be appropriate after diagnosis, and some resets erase accounts, tuned channels and personal settings.
Match the appointment to the address and installation

Greater Noida and Greater Noida West cover different routes from the Delhi workshop. Include the precise sector, nearest landmark and society name rather than just a broad city label. Mention whether the property is a plotted house, a high-rise flat or an office; the access and working space can change what is practical during inspection.

If a failure seems linked to an inverter or generator changeover, describe the sequence. Have electrical supply concerns checked by a qualified electrician rather than testing exposed connections. The TV must also be assessed, because an unstable power supply and an internal fault can produce similar shutdown symptoms.
